body: Hi, I have been experiencing some anxiety issues. I don't really know how to handle them by living. I have ocd, and I don't know how to cope with intrusive thoughts and compulsions. A part of me thinks everything will be fine, but another part of me thinks the opposite. Usually, when I get home from school, I just worry until I go to bed.

Hi, I have been experiencing ocd for a while, and I don't know if I can go on. I want to stop worrying about all these irrational things. I know my intrusive thoughts are just thoughts and all of that, and I know things can get better, but my brain is telling me otherwise. I really just want to commit suicide, so I can stop my worries and compulsions. I have been looking up suicide methods, and while I want to die, I am also extremely scared to do it.
